brief.goal: Get freelancers who invoice international clients to open a Wise account

facts.statement: Wise locks in the exchange rate for up to 24 hours so the recipient receives the agreed amount.
facts.quote: Lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours. If the rate drops, you won’t lose out.

facts.statement: Wise provides global account details for receiving money in 22 currencies.
facts.quote:
Get paid easily in other currencies with global account details.

22 currencies

[Explore getting paid](https://wise.com/us/receive-money)

facts.statement: Wise lets customers pay and withdraw cash worldwide without hidden fees or markups in 215 countries and territories.
facts.quote:
Pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups.

215 countries and territories

[Learn about Wise cards](https://wise.com/us/card)

facts.statement: Wise offers an opt-in interest feature with passthrough FDIC insurance of up to $250,000 through its program bank.
facts.quote: Opt in and get passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through our Program Bank. [2](https://wise.com/#disclaimer-anchor-1) [3](https://wise.com/#disclaimer-anchor-2)

facts.statement: Wise provides account details for receiving money in AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP, HUF, NZD, PHP, SGD, and USD.
facts.quote: Get paid like a local in AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP, HUF, NZD, PHP, SGD, USD without fees — no matter where you are.

facts.statement: Wise users can send same-currency payments directly to another Wise Account without fees.
facts.quote: People can send same-currency payments directly to your Wise Account in a flash.

facts.statement: Wise Business combines payments, receiving money, spending, and earning returns across different currencies in one account.
facts.quote: Make payments, get paid, spend and earn returns in different currencies. Save time, money and hassle with the all-in-one Wise Business account.

facts.statement: Wise says that 96% of payments to international partners take less than 24 hours.
facts.quote: Pay suppliers in hours, not days— 96% of payments take less than 24 hours.*

facts.statement: Wise Business lets businesses accept customer payments in 22 currencies, including USD, EUR, and GBP.
facts.quote: 22 currencies Accept payments from international customers— in USD, EUR, GBP and other major currencies with no hidden fees.

facts.statement: Wise says its Interest feature offers a variable 3.4% APY on USD without locking funds away.
facts.quote: With our interest feature, you can earn on your money without ever locking it away. So it's always ready for whenever you need it.

facts.statement: Wise Business provides physical and digital cards for teams in 231 countries and territories.
facts.quote: Get physical and digital cards for your team, separate your money and control your spending. 231 countries and territories

facts.statement: Wise Business integrates with accounting software to provide reporting for every currency.
facts.quote: Integrate your Wise account with accounting software and get fast, accurate reporting for every currency.

facts.statement: Wise offers an international business account for businesses making payments and receiving money in more than 40 currencies.
facts.quote: Go global with our international business account. Make payments and get paid in 40+ currencies. Join over 900,000 businesses thriving with Wise.

facts.statement: Users can receive their primary income or pension directly into Wise from their employer.
facts.quote: Share your Wise Account details with your employer, and receive your primary income or pension directly into Wise. Then, convert it to whatever currency you like.

facts.statement: Wise Business is designed for small businesses that need to pay and get paid internationally.
facts.quote: Wise Business makes it easy for small businesses to pay and get paid. Do business without borders.

facts.statement: Wise Business helps startups receive investor funding in local currencies and expand internationally.
facts.quote: Wise Business lets you receive investor funding in local currencies while benefiting from our market-leading FX rate. Extend your runway with Wise and help your startup go global.

facts.statement: Wise Business helps freelancers get paid by clients in different currencies.
facts.quote: Wise Business is the quick and easy way to get paid by clients in different currencies - making payment admin painless.

facts.statement: Wise says that 18.9 million customers, businesses, and banks use it every day and move $16 billion monthly.
facts.quote: 18.9 million customers, businesses and banks use Wise every day. They move $16 billion every month. Here’s how we keep each dollar safe.

facts.statement: Wise says it is regulated nationwide and has 65 licences worldwide.
facts.quote: Regulated nationwide, with 65 licences worldwide to keep your money moving.

facts.statement: Wise says more than 1,000 experts and its systems run 7 million fraud checks daily.
facts.quote: Over 1,000 experts and our smart systems run 7 million checks every day to spot and stop fraud.

facts.statement: More than 900,000 global businesses move and spend $16 billion through Wise each month.
facts.quote: Over 900,000 global businesses move and spend $16 billion per month.

facts.statement: Rident Royalties says Wise's batch payments feature reduced client payment time from nearly a week to a few minutes.
facts.quote: Sending payments to all our clients used to take me close to a week, and with Wise's batch payments feature, I can accomplish this in just a few minutes.

facts.statement: Wise says it uses a standout exchange rate comparable to the rate shown on Google.
facts.quote: Banks and other providers inflate the mid-market exchange rate to hide fees and make you pay more. Not Wise. You’ll always get our stand-out rate, like the one on Google.

facts.statement: Wise lets users receive and add money to their Wise Account for free.
facts.quote: Receive and add money to your Wise Account for free. For some currencies, we offer faster or more convenient options for a small fee, too.

facts.statement: Wise always provides a free alternative when some faster payment methods have a fixed fee.
facts.quote: Some faster methods of sending money, like wire payments in US dollars, have a fixed fee — but there’ll always be a free alternative.

facts.statement: Users can add money to Wise Account via bank transfer for free when the currency stays the same.
facts.quote: Add money to Wise Account via bank transfer for free when the currency stays the same. Pay a small fee to add USD or CAD.

facts.statement: Wise offers wire transfers from $1.13 and says U.S. banks typically charge fees of $25 or more.
facts.quote: Send wire transfers from as low as $1.13— Skip the $25+ fee typically charged by U.S. banks.

facts.statement: Wise compares its total fees and recipient amount with Wells Fargo.
facts.quote:
Recipient gets

![Wise](https://dq8dwmysp7hk1.cloudfront.net/logos/wise-mark.svg)Wise🎉 **Save up to 44.03 USD** in total fees889.92 EUR

![Wells Fargo](https://dq8dwmysp7hk1.cloudfront.net/logos/wells-fargo-mark.svg)Wells Fargo**30.68 USD** in total fees867.36 EUR
